features.title: Context Window Optimization and Tool Sandboxing Engine
acceptance: Intercepts verbose tool and terminal outputs and folds lines above threshold, achieving up to 98% context token reduction.
Enforces hard wall-clock execution timeouts to prevent hung processes across agent platforms.
Indexes output chunks into SQLite FTS5 for precision on-demand retrieval.
Provides interactive frontend sandbox runner and live token savings visualization.

features.title: Classifier-Safe Advisory Session Guidance and Multi-Platform Registry
acceptance: Formats non-imperative advisory tool guidance blocks to avoid auto-mode bypass security denials.
Provides quiet-mode toggle to eliminate injected transcript blocks for security-conscious users.

features.title: Invariant-Preserving Token Economics and Model Pricing Comparison
acceptance: Strictly verifies that per-session kept out tokens never exceed global totals.
Reports zero savings for sessions with zero tool executions.
Calculates counterfactual cost comparisons across Claude, GPT, and Gemini model tiers.

features.title: Multi-Platform Agent Hooks and Process Watchdog Adapters
acceptance: Provides platform-specific hook definitions for OpenCode V2, Pi, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
Enforces parent-death polling guards to prevent orphaned background processes on Windows and Linux.
